title: Fantastic photo tour,  fantastic guide!
text: Tirma was a brilliant guide and gave excellent advice on the best photo shots and how to really look around us for the many varied possibilities to get that special shot. As she explained, sometimes the moment has to be seized and the shot has to be swift, other times it needs a lot of patience! You will also walk through old parts of Barcelona that you would probably never otherwise see. Tirma is a lovely person and very enthusiastic about her photography and helping other people with their photographic skills. I wish her the very best success in her career and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommen
author: Pamelalu92

title: Great for all skill levels. Insightful guide with photography tips. Beautiful locations to explore.
text: I joined the Photography Workshop in the Gothic Quarter and El Born, and it was fantastic! The guide was friendly and gave great tips for taking photos. The locations were stunning, with narrow streets and beautiful architecture. Perfect for beginners and pros alike. Highly recommend for a unique way to explore Barcelona!
author: hongyoungy
